name: Oogami Koga
source:
A lone hunter whose purpose in life is rock. He hates a conservative approach. Although hot-blooded and short-tempered, Koga's pretty sensible. He goes all out in his flashy performances with a passionate, powerful voice.

A member of Rhythm Link's UNDEAD.

[From in-game profile]
